items.title: The data proves it: Bitcoin doesn't care about rising bond yields over long-term
items.summary: Long-term, BTC ignores rising bond yields. In the short term, however, surging bond volatility could easily dampen crypto's animal spirits.

items.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
items.summary: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

items.title: Trump administration weighs a global stablecoin plan to cement dollar's dominance
items.summary: Washington is a mulling plan to actively promote USD-backed stablecoins worldwide in a bid to cement the greenback's global reserve status.

items.title: A week of AI coding cut a quantum-safe bitcoin transaction estimate from $320 to $66
items.summary: StarkWare, which conducted the research, says contest participants using AI tools made the computation about five times faster, though the $66 figure has not yet been demonstrated in another transaction mined on Bitcoin.

items.title: Dogecoin down 8%, bitcoin under $84,000 as Treasury yields hit highest level since 2007
items.summary: A rebound in oil, the strongest U.S. business survey in five years and a poorly received five-year note sale pushed borrowing costs higher, with DOGE leading token losses.
